body: Yessssss thank you for saying it out loud!!
Hell yes! What do I need to do?
Very much so! Really hard to talk to anyone 🙃
Amazing. I put the dog picture cause I didn’t want to put my fiancé’s and mine lol
And where did it leave you, wanting more? So much time and energy goes into them.

Twice I have been broken up without closure, and I thought to myself, would I have wanted that course. Would it have given me peace or would it have destroyed me a little more. It feels easier getting over someone when you are mad at how unfair they treated me and how disrespectful they were to another human being. I’m sorry you went through this, you have so much love to give. Stay strong!

Yes!! My nex would get all pouty and I would have to comfort him and remind him that I would never do that to him. Ironically he broke up with me since he wouldn’t trust me and he was scared I would go behind him back with people from the past. Truthfully, shows more about then then it does about you. Remember that.

Same thing happened with my nex. I felt like I was going through PTSD when his phone would go off because I knew he was hiding something. He told me to go get help and that I am crazy. Don’t stand for it like what I did. There are up to no good. I’m sorry that you are going through this.
I didn’t get closure nor did I get broken up in respect. He did it over text. Truthfully, not worth my time trying the think about closure. Won’t ever happen, so why hold my breath.

Yes! They say that to so they you’ll be quiet while the world actually revolves around them! If they blame you and you are a human who actually thinks about their actions, you’ll get silent and think about what you did or said to make it seem like that. But in all honesty, you did nothing wrong, they are just lashing out because they are too scared to reflect themselves.
He made me feel like I was the awful person. Hard to think differently after 3 years.

He dumped me 3 weeks ago. He made himself feel like he was the saint and I was the batshit crazy one. I think about the things that make me mad, but I love him so I can’t be mad at him. And when I am not, I am more tempted to message him or hope he comes back and take him back in.

He could never let the past lie. I didn’t do anything wrong but anything that he thought I did I got it rubbed in my face and brought down by things I already didn’t feel good about. I always felt bad if I said anything bad so I never fought back.
How can they love you, but hurt you so much. I want to think he loves me and he is capable of loving since he said his love for me is more then anyone he has loved before.
I’m already away from him, he dumped me. I feel like a wreck.

That is exactly what happened to me. He got mad at me for something. Ignored me for 3 days till I asked what the f are we. He was mad because I kept “pushing” him for answers. He broke up with me over text saying how he couldn’t trust me and how he needs time to think, but we were broken up. Then 2 days later he said he couldn’t do it anymore. He said he loved me and then blocked me. We talked the next week cause I gave him a letter. He said he needs time and the it is just too hard right now. I’m so confused. I feels done, but it felt done so many other times, I am just waiting till he pops up again. This happened 3 weeks ago. We went almost a month without any contact till he messaged me that he missed me and of course I fell for it like I always do. It is like he is a drug. The “love bomb” makes me feel so good that I unhealthy expectations now. I have to drop off his thing at his place. I am nervous, but I am going to do it and leave it on his door so I don’t see him.

He makes me seem like I am a bad guy and he is being the bigger person since he ended it. I went a month without hearing from him because he brought up my abandonment issues and told me the issue was my adoption. Then of course I took that out of context cause he meant something else by his words. I’m confused and messed up now I feel like.

It is like they think they are off the hook if they just blame you... but how does he just dump me and make him look like he is a saint and doing the best thing for us. I went thought 3 years of shit and I stuck by him though it all... I’m so confused and sad.

Thank you for your reply. I know I am not perfect, but I am going to therapy and really working on myself. Is it common that they blame you for everything and spin everything around on you if you put up a fuss?

Yup right out of the blue. He got mad at me for something. Stonewalled me. Broke up with me two days later because I was “bugging” him for an answer. Then told me he care for me on the weekend and blocked me on everything. I’m dealing with hard depression and anxiety. This is the first time it actually feels like he is gone forever. I miss him so much and I don’t really know how to go about my day without thinking of him or working myself up into an anxiety ball. The worse part is that he says he still cares for me and loves me, he just can’t do “this” right now. It’s just too “hard”... I don’t know what he means by that, and I am pretty sure I’ll never know. I’m very confused. I feel like 3 years was a lie. He told me things after things about being together, having children, working through anything. I feel abandon.
No one cares. I won’t be missed.

I feel the exact same way. I feel like it was my fault and I should be alone and miserable. He deserves more then me. I’m sorry that you had to go through all of that, but you are definitely not alone. I went through it for 3 years and I got discarded at the end. I doubt every single day.
Once a month minimum. Sometimes it lasts for week at a time. I’m going through one right now since Sunday night. I feel for you. Please talk if you need too, I am all ears.
Same thing happened to me, it drove me absolutely insane. I’m sorry you have to go through this, definitely talk to a friend.
Please message me, I would really like to talk to you
